name: MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL (Xiaomi FP8)
notes: Xiaomi's MoE, 309B total / 15B active, sliding-window attention so the KV cache is cheap; up to 1M context. Xiaomi's own FP8 build, the same size class as GLM-5.3-Flash. Needs its patch set: the image's FP8 loader mis-shards qkv at TP=2. Settings from the model card; recommended sampling temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95.
